title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Strawberry Burst Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Strawberry Burst delivers the timeless taste of soft, ripe strawberries for a smooth, sweet vape that’s sure to satisfy. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, offering extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Designed with dual mesh coil technology, these pods produce consistently smooth vapour and bold, authentic flavour. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design make refilling effortless, ensuring a hassle-free vaping experience. Together, the pod and refill container provide up to 6000 puffs, making it a perfect choice for vapers who prioritise convenience and great taste. Filled with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, these pods deliver a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, ideal for both experienced and new adult vapers. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the sweet and smooth Strawberry Burst flavour.
